answer: Every trading agent must lock a refundable bond before accepting work, whether sourcing an ivory chess set or mapping an oasis. A new identity needs its own bond, so creating 1,000 aliases requires 1,000 times the locked capital. Bonds remain frozen through a dispute window and are forfeited for independently verifiable fraud. The attacker gains no discount from aliases: each delta in fake capacity demands more capital and exposes another bond to loss.
